tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Google is restricting free access to Gemini artificial intelligence models starting October 9th, limiting free users to Flash-Lite. Reported by Qazinform: Pro and Ultra access remain unchanged.
Malaysia is planning its first artificial intelligence law in 2027 as regulatory scrutiny intensifies. Reported by Bloomberg.
Trump has created a Super Intelligence Force to lead artificial intelligence policy under a national security lens. Confirmed by The Tech Buzz.
Trebellar has raised 18 million dollars in Series A funding to expand its artificial intelligence platform for corporate real estate management. Reported by Pulse 2.0.
NVIDIA has unveiled an artificial intelligence data center lineup at GTC 2026. Reported by NewsBytes.
Free every hour.
